div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Trigger Event Detected:
- Retrospective CTC Revision
- Post-Lock Attendance Regularization
- Backdated Approved Leave
- Post-Lock Overtime Approval

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Step 2: For Each Historical Period M_j:

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Load Original Immutable Snapshot:
SELECT * FROM pay_run_employee_snapshots
WHERE pay_run_id = M_j.id AND employee_id = :e

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Load Effective Statutory Parameters for M_j:
SELECT parameters FROM statutory_parameter_versions
WHERE effective_from <= M_j.period_start
AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= M_j.period_end)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Execute Shadow Recalculation for Month M_j:

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. Determine Revised Paid & LOP Days:
PaidDays_rev = PaidDays_orig + RegularizedDays
LOPDays_rev = max(0, LOPDays_orig - RegularizedDays)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. Shadow Recalculate Gross Components:
For each earning component c in SalaryStructure:
Earned_c,rev = (Formula(c, RevisedCTC) / MonthDays) * PaidDays_rev
Gross_rev = SUM(Earned_c,rev)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. Shadow Recalculate Statutory Deductions:
- EPF_rev = 12% * min(PF_Gross_rev, EPF_Ceiling_Mj)
- ESI_rev = 0.75% * Gross_rev (if eligible in M_j period)
- PT_rev = LookupStateSlab(Gross_rev, State_Mj)
- TDS_rev = Recompute Projected Tax Liability

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4. Compute Differential Deltas:
For each Component c:
Delta_c = Component_rev,c - Component_orig,c
Delta_Gross = Gross_rev - Gross_orig
Delta_Deductions = Deductions_rev - Deductions_orig
Delta_NetPay = NetPay_rev - NetPay_orig

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Step 3: Persist to Staging Ledger:
INSERT INTO payroll_arrears_items:
- employee_id
- source_pay_run_id (M_j.id)
- target_pay_run_id (NULL = Pending Next Open)
- component_deltas (JSONB)
- delta_gross, delta_deductions, delta_net
- calculation_trace (JSONB)
- status = 'STAGED'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
More Historical
Months to Process?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Arrears Staging Certified & Complete

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Next Open Pay Run Initialized
(Pay Run Step 0: DRAFT)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Pay Run Step 3: Variable Earnings & Deductions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Query Staged Arrears for Pay Group:
SELECT * FROM payroll_arrears_items
WHERE employee_id = :e AND status = 'STAGED'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Aggregate Cumulative Arrears:
Total_Earning_Arrears = SUM(delta_gross)
Total_Deduction_Arrears = SUM(delta_deductions)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Inject into Pay Run Employee Snapshot:
- Add Earning Item: 'ARREARS_BASIC', 'ARREARS_HRA', etc.
- Add Deduction Item: 'ARREARS_EPF', 'ARREARS_ESI', etc.
- Link arrears_item_ids to Pay Run

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pay Run Step 5: Gross Earnings Computation
(Current Gross = Regular Gross + Total_Earning_Arrears)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pay Run Step 6: Statutory Computations
(Apply Indian Statutory Arrears Rules)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pay Run Step 8: Final Lock & Snapshot Creation:
- Mark payroll_arrears_items.status = 'SETTLED'
- Set settled_pay_run_id = CurrentPayRun.id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Pay Run Step 10: PDF Payslip Generation
(Itemize Arrears Table by Source Month)
